title: Safety Concept Vectors for Reasoning Chain Monitoring

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear chain: if concept probes on reasoning tokens predict unsafe outputs better than last-token probing, this enables early intervention during chain-of-thought generation. Directly addresses a growing concern about reasoning model safety.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires running a reasoning model, extracting activations at each token position, and applying concept probes token-by-token. Medium compute handles this for a single model. The token-by-token extraction is a straightforward extension of standard probing but requires some familiarity with model internals.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped: apply existing concept probes to reasoning token positions and compare predictive accuracy to last-token-only probing. Single experiment with a clear metric (predictive accuracy at each position). Completable in 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
